commit 978c912c7089fa4573add7140170feb9fcbe7f87
Author: Frank Morgner <frankmorgner@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Jul 30 02:26:25 2020 +0200

    fixed Heap-buffer-overflow READ

    7cf8087351c821aa1e617282db93ecb33d53d918 seemed to be incomplete. Change
    the length of the buffer right before it's accessed.

    fixes https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase-detail/5734055866531840

 src/libopensc/card-asepcos.c | 12 ++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 10 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
===
43379b3b coolkey: Rewrite coolkey_rsa_op() for better readability
63435adc coolkey: Do not return bogus error if read already failed
2a0f53dd coolkey: Avoid heap buffer overflow
ee78b0b8 pkcs15-coolkey: Fix EC key type and fail on invalid key types
f11c286b coolkey: Refactor the object listing to avoid invalid memory access
c173563a coolkey: Accept only SW=90 00 as success to prevent interpretting invalid values
5ec26573 coolkey: Do not overflow allocated buffer
